quotes.author: chun man chu
quotes.text: I joined the tour “The Best of West Kelowna” with my partner yesterday. Brian was our guide and he showed great hospitality to us. Really awesome that we are the only group of 2 like a private tour. Riding with a comfy Ford, he introduced us the history of wineries and even Kelowna. He is very knowledgeable in wine. He knows we are keen on tasting Icewine and he put it as our priority. We all had fun after visiting 5 wineries. This is a great experience we haven’t had before. Thank you Brian!

quotes.author: Hanny V
quotes.text: Wine tasting in Canada We had a great afternoon with Brian, who was our gide and driver. The variety in wine estastes was very good. We learned a lot about the wine making in Canada, which is different from what we learned in South Afrika and New Zeeland. Also the tasting is different, without using water en new glasses for every new wine. We loved the locations and the clear explanation about every new wine. It was a lovely afternoon. Thank you Brian!

quotes.author: S P
quotes.text: Wonderful wine day in the Okanagan Wonderful day spent touring 5 wineries in West Kelowna with a stop for lunch. Our guide Brian was fantastic providing us with great information on the local area and what to expect at each of the wineries. Marsha did a great job for us providing us with guidance on the vineyards that would be of most interest outside two that we had chosen. Overall a fantastic day. I would highly recommend this experience to others.

quotes.author: Patti J
quotes.text: Beyond our expectations Cal, our guide, was fabulous and guided us through an exceptional day. He was full of knowledge in the region and had a great sense of humour. We did the South Okanagan Day Tripper and toured five exceptional wineries. At each stop we were educated on the wines being served and the wine experts were welcoming and highly personable. Terrafina (the restaurant at Hester Creek Winery) was delicious.

quotes.author: Mike F
quotes.text: A gentle afternoon amongst the wineries. We visited 4 wineries east of Kelowna. Each offered several wines which were described very clearly. The ambience was universally pleasant. What really enhanced our tour was our guide,Cal Anderson, who was a local tour guide, social historian and wine enthusiast combined. We moved at a gentle pace on a lovely day with easy, relaxed conversation . Cal gets 5 stars from us.

quotes.author: Isa J
quotes.text: We were very pleased with the private tour organized with them, it was one day with 4 specific wineries to visit including a winery with lunch. It was a great pleasure to learn about the area and taste some great wines! Cal, our tour guide, was knowledgeable and easygoing. The day went by quickly and he recommended many restaurants/places to go during our stay. Thank you Cal and OKwine tour!!
